claim_verdicts.L01: KEEP: decreasing finite-ball events and polynomial probabilities imply right continuity by upper semicontinuity plus monotonicity.
claim_verdicts.L02: KEEP: finite Russo measures converge weakly to the critical survival atom; a critical atom is not excluded.
claim_verdicts.L03: KEEP as exact equivalence: necessity controls large n by one f_N(p_c) and finitely many small n by continuity; sufficiency takes n-limit of each critical-window increment. The condition G01 remains unproved.
claim_verdicts.L04: KEEP: level means M_n=2^(n+k_n)p^n, conditional variance increments (1-p)/M_n, and E W_n^2<=pi^2/6 at p=1/2 give survival >=6/pi^2. The graph is not quasi-transitive.
claim_verdicts.L05: KEEP: at most n open pivotals on a surviving root-to-level-n tree path gives the derivative upper bound; the critical atom still has positive mass.
claim_verdicts.L06: KEEP: forward-tree curvature bound and open-pivotal identity give D(1+2/c_b) on [1/(2b),1/b].
claim_verdicts.L07: KEEP with explicit mass-transport assumption: each edge is incident to two vertices, yielding the factor 1/2 and the full incoming-center sum; no uniform spatial-tail bound follows.
claim_verdicts.L08: KEEP: independently checked s_m<=1/(1+c_b m) and p s_m'<=m s_m; hence f_n'<=D(m+1)/(1+c_b m)<=D/c_b on [0,1/b], with p=0 by polynomial continuity. For D=3, 12 replaces 27 on a wider interval.
claim_verdicts.G01: KEEP only as explicit unproved input; it is equivalent in force to the parent target.

claim_verdicts.R02: KEEP FIX of source scope: Cerf arXiv:2608.23661 abstract explicitly concerns Bernoulli site percolation on Z^d, d>=3; no bond or arbitrary-graph transfer follows from that abstract.
